ceremony.name: Sign-in by trigger link (browser, community service, member's wallet)
ceremony.choreography: docs/26-paired-ceremonies.md section 4: request, claim, the match number shown to the browser only, identify and prove, the grant, respond, redeem; negatives for a wrong number, a second claim, a non-member and a cancel, a stranger's redeem, a proof after a cancel, a respond under the wrong key, a grant for another digest and a broken identify; a version step-down against an older community and an old wallet against a current one

scenarios.title: sign-in by trigger link: the browser opens a request, the member's wallet claims it, the browser shows the match number, the wallet identifies its member and proves with that number, the member approves, and the browser redeems a session for the member (the wallet's agent is a class D stand-in; the community's DID document is a stand-in carrying the sign-in services)
spec: TF specs/auth/oob/request/0.2/spec.md (the starter opens a request; the service answers a requestId and claimClosesAt)
TF specs/auth/oob/claim/0.2/spec.md (the approver claims with a fresh lock key; the community's answer is its signed attestation)
TF specs/auth/oob/redeem/0.2/spec.md (only the starter key's holder is told the match number; a redeem returns the session once approved)
TF specs/auth/oob/prove/0.3/spec.md (the approver proves with identify and the entered number)
TF specs/auth/oob/respond/0.3/spec.md (the approver responds with the signed grant)
TF specs/auth/oob/_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md (request states; proof purposes; disclosure ladder)
docs/26-paired-ceremonies.md section 4
